answer: Clone crews reserved the night silt-gauge slots at the north delta mouth and never left the boathouse, so the 02:07 flood crest was missed. To keep a slot, a claimant must carry the 2.40 kg sounding staff from shed D-6, climb 42 m of the spiral stair to landing L-3, and hang the staff on hook 9-1 before the 02:22 gale horn. Mass must stay within 20 g, the climb 55-80 s, and the hook photo must show the shed serial and the landing stamp. A 125-chip retainer is held until that photo and the clerk tally agree. A reused photo or a staff that never leaves shed D-6 voids the slot for five horns.
